name: Lahsbane
description: Lahsbane was a planet located in the Onatos sector of the Mid Rim, that served as the home for the Lahsbee and Huhk species—the small and peaceful Lahsbee, who lived in Lahsbane's forests, inevitably grew into the large and aggressive Huhk in the planet's cities. Remote and resource-poor, Lahsbane was left uncharted until an Imperial expedition happened across the world sometime before 3 ABY. During the Galactic Civil War, Rebel spy Yom Argo crashed and died on Lahsbane.
